findings.text: The changed module docstring says that the fresh-send rules and the fresh-run rules of UPDATE, DELETE and ADD COLUMN build on `check_send_single_of_step`, but after this commit no declaration in the packages uses it and only retention fixtures under `tests/surface` do. Fix: state that the retention fixtures are its only users, or delete the sentence.

The new fixture module has no module docstring that says which test owns it and which code of this repository it checks. Fix: add a `/-! A fixture module of tests/surface_schema_script_test.py: ... -/` docstring that names `Sql.check_send_of_rule` as the subject and the two deleted laws that it retains.

The commit deletes the named `roleOf` and puts the outcome tag `reached` and its binder names `selected` and `choice` as literals inside `processPremises`, although ADR 0033 D6 says the read-path part of `roleOf` stays. Fix: keep a named definition with a docstring in `SqlRunRules.lean` for the outcome premise and its binder names, and use it in `processPremises`.

The status file assumes that some tests still use the general send rule to test the old diagnostic, but this commit replaced those fixtures in `S6AutoPaths` and `S6AutoShapes` with the new diagnostic, and the only remaining uses are the retention witnesses through `ReplacedGeneralSend`. Fix: delete "or tests of the old diagnostic" and name the witness modules.

The status file names no relevant source files and no tests for this commit, but `AGENTS.md` requires the status file to refer to the relevant source files and to name the tests that touch the change. Fix: list the changed `SqlRun*` modules and `KindRuleSend.lean`, and name `tests/surface_schema_script_test.py` and `tests/surface_s6_automation_test.py` as the tests of this commit.
